purpose: Premium Visual & Generative Motion Layer. Load only after Operational Master + visual architecture are known.

styleSystem.rule: Every visual architecture has exactly three curated, materially distinct premium style directions.

motionLibrary.thirdPartyRule: license + provenance + deterministic smoke render required before production

lottie.rule: Third-party Lottie remains review-only until license/provenance, deterministic render, brand adaptation and visual QA pass.

generativeVideo.preferredMode: image-to-video when an approved first frame can constrain composition

runtime.generative: short conceptual clips assembled under deterministic overlays

selectionProtocol: 1. Keep the selected visual architecture from claude/visual-directions.compact.json.
2. Read the single matching record from src/registry/premium-style-presets.json and present its three curated premium style directions; do not invent a fourth merely for variety.
3. Read only the selected style family record after the user or automatic planner chooses a direction.
4. Prefer a style that solves the brief without defaulting to full-frame primary color.

5. Read only motion modules relevant to the selected style + storyboard beats. All 39 premium modules have an executable first-party implementation; choose by narrative fit, not by availability pressure.
6. Use external Lottie/video only if its specific license/provenance is recorded and productionReady=true; otherwise use it as inspiration only.
7. Classify every proposed generated scene before calling a video provider.
8. Keep all facts and official identity in deterministic layers.
9. Build a scene-level premium production plan and run scripts/audit-premium-production.mjs before export.
10. Run factual + safe-area + readability preflight in addition to anti-generic QA.
